newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Apr-May spending up 8.1 pct on yr ago.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Apr-May spending up 8.1 pct on yr ago.

text.p: South Africa's Finance Department said on Friday that 14.46 billion rand was requested from the exchequer in May by government departments and agencies, compared to April's 17.51 billion rand.

This brought exchequer issues for the first two months of the financial year (April and May) to 31.970 billion rand, the department said in a statement. The total was 8.1 percent up on the 29.565 billion rand issued over the same period a year ago.
Total revenue and grants for May rose to 10.985 billion rand, 14.0 percent higher than in the same month a year ago.
Total revenue and grants for April and May combined to 21.937 billion, 9.2 percent higher than the comparable period last year:
NOTE - The statement said a breakdown of revenue figures had not yet been finalised and would be published in a statement in July.
